# Magic: grimoires & spells

[Home](README.md) · [Getting started](getting-started.md) · [Magic](magic.md) · [Abyss Fruits](fruits.md) · [AI & simulation](ai-and-simulation.md) · [World events](world-events.md) · [Mobs & bosses](mobs-and-bosses.md) · [Items & recipes](items-and-recipes.md) · [Progression](progression.md) · [Commands](commands.md) · [FAQ](faq.md) · [Development](development.md)

---

Every player can hold **one grimoire**. The Grimoire Altar picks its attribute at random (odds below). Each grimoire has four spells, unlocked at magic levels **1, 3, 6 and 10**. Spell power grows 5% per level (max level 20).

**Casting:** hold your grimoire and **Use** to cast the selected spell, **Sneak + Use** to flip to the next unlocked spell (or choose one in the Handbook). Spells cost mana and have cooldowns; the HUD shows both. Creative players may use any grimoire, with every spell unlocked and free.

## Anti-Magic

A five-leaf grimoire holds no spells - its pages hold **demon swords**. "Cast" a page to draw that sword.

| Sword | Melee damage | Use ability |
|---|---|---|
| Demon-Slayer Sword | 12 | **Black Meteorite** - a piercing anti-magic slash wave that also cuts enemy spells out of the air |
| Demon-Dweller Sword | 9 | **Spell Return** - swallows every hostile spell or projectile within 8 blocks and fires them back (a flash-slash dash if nothing is near) |
| Demon-Destroyer Sword | 10 | **Curse-Breaker Thrust** - a dash that strips every effect from enemies it hits and cleanses your own debuffs |

* Sword hits fill the **Anti-Magic gauge** (so do taking hits and killing magical enemies). At 100% cast **Black Form**: 30 s of strength, speed, resistance, a black-lightning aura and stronger sword abilities.
* **Sneak** while holding a demon sword to cut down incoming spells and projectiles automatically.
* Demon swords deal bonus damage to magical enemies and strip their buffs; hits and Black Meteorite slashes **seal Abyss Fruit powers** for a few seconds.

## Techniques

* **Mana Skin** (magic level 12): a coat of mana soaks a quarter of every hit, paid for with mana.
* **Mana Zone** (magic level 15): hold your grimoire and press **Sneak + Jump**. For 20 s, inside a 12-block zone, your spells recharge twice as fast, hit 20% harder and mana regenerates twice as fast.
